name: Life Draining Thunder
disable: DC 35 Thievery check (master) to destroy the key rune, DC 37 Arcana check (master) to harmlessly discharge the runes, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap

items.name: Thunderous Lifedrain
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 5 feet of either double door

---

Effect All living creatures in the room take 9d6 void,9d6 sonic damage (DC 33 basic Reflex save).

text: Thassilonian runes set with onyx erupt with negative energy and thunderous roars at the presence of a living creature.
